Class Theme

java.lang.Object
mesos.client.ui.resource.Theme
public final class Theme extends Object
Visual palette for the client UI. Canonical colours extracted from the official MESOS materials: box cover (Box_ITA_PREV.pdf) and playmat (fustelle_front-p1.png). Player colours match pedine_specs.pdf Pantone refs.
